dict.string: PinBoard reads only the photos and videos you pick to pin. It never changes or deletes anything in your library; saving to Photos only adds new items, and only when you ask.
PinBoard adds a pin's picture or video to Photos only when you choose Save to Photos.
PinBoard uses the camera only to take a photo when you choose Camera from the + menu.
PinBoard listens to your videos on this device to write their transcripts. Nothing is sent anywhere.
PinBoard uses Face ID to unlock your Hidden section.
